title: Daily Routine Inspection Checklist
description: Completed by CFR twice daily (05:30am and post-operations). Submitted to OM.

footer.dateLine: Date: March 12, 2026. Maintenance Paved and Unpaved Manual.

items.text: Surface free of potholes (any bowl-shaped hole in pavement surface)
No loose asphalt or aggregate pieces constituting FOD on runway surface
No alligator/fatigue cracking with loose material
No transverse or longitudinal cracks wider than approximately 25 mm (1 inch)
No rutting or wheel-path depressions visible on runway surface
No shoving, rippling, or permanent deformation of asphalt surface
No depressions collecting standing water on runway surface
No oil, fuel, hydraulic fluid, or other liquid spills on runway surface
Surface free of all FOD (stones, debris, hardware, wildlife remains, etc.)
Runway centerline marking visible and white, continuous full length
Runway threshold markings all bars present and visible at Threshold 07
Runway threshold markings all bars present and visible at Threshold 25
Runway designation '07’ legible at Threshold 07 end
Runway designation '25’ legible at Threshold 25 end
Runway aiming point markings visible at both ends
Runway touchdown zone markings visible at both ends
Holding position markings at Taxiway Alpha / Runway intersection visible, correct pattern
Runway edge lights all visually confirmed as intact (during pre- dawn or night operations)
Runway threshold lights visually intact
No erosion of runway edges creating edge drop-off > 50 mm
Runway drainage gutters (both edges) free of blockage, water flowing
Turn pad at Threshold 07 end surface free of potholes and loose material
Turn pad at Threshold 07 end no standing water or significant debris
Turn pad at Threshold 25 end surface free of potholes and loose material
Turn pad at Threshold 25 end no standing water or significant debris
Turn pad surrounds adjacent unpaved areas free of objects > 7.5 cm height
Surface free of potholes and loose material throughout full length
No joint spalling producing loose concrete fragments
No cracks or joint openings wider than approximately 25 mm
No differential settlement visible between adjacent concrete slabs
No standing water on taxiway surface or in adjacent drainage channels
No FOD on taxiway surface or shoulders
Taxiway centerline marking yellow, continuous, full length
Taxiway edge markings visible on both edges
No oil or fuel spills on surface
Shoulders (7.5 m each side) intact, no erosion encroaching onto pavement edge

sections.title: SECTION 4 — TAXIWAY BRAVO AND TAXIWAY CHARLIE (CONCRETE)

items.text: Taxiway Bravo surface free of potholes and loose material
Taxiway Bravo no joint spalling with loose fragments
Taxiway Bravo no standing water on surface
Taxiway Bravo centerline marking visible and continuous
Taxiway Charlie surface free of potholes and loose material
Taxiway Charlie no joint spalling with loose fragments
Taxiway Charlie no standing water on surface
Taxiway Charlie centerline marking visible and continuous
No potholes or spalled concrete creating FOD on apron surface
No cracked or lifted slab corners anywhere on apron
No joint spalling with loose concrete pieces
No standing water on apron surface or in drainage channels
No FOD anywhere on apron surface
No fuel, oil, or fluid spills creating surface hazards
Aircraft stand lead-in lines and stand numbers visible and legible
Apron safety lines (equipment exclusion zones) visible
No evidence of concrete slab heaving or unusual differential settlement
Apron drainage channel gratings in place and not displaced
RESA beyond Threshold 07 completely clear of all objects > 7.5 cm height
RESA beyond Threshold 07 ground surface level, no significant depressions or mounds
RESA beyond Threshold 07 no standing water
RESA beyond Threshold 25 completely clear of all objects > 7.5 cm height
RESA beyond Threshold 25 ground surface level, no significant depressions or mounds
RESA beyond Threshold 25 no standing water

sections.title: SECTION 7 — RUNWAY STRIP AND SAFETY AREAS (UNPAVED)

items.text: Runway strip grass areas no objects > 7.5 cm height visible from inspection vehicle
Runway strip no significant flooding or inundated areas adjacent to runway edges
No unauthorized vehicles, equipment, or structures visible in runway strip
No visible wildlife congregation of concern in runway strip or RESA areas
No unauthorized persons on the movement area
No unauthorized vehicles or ground equipment in the movement area
All visible lighting infrastructure (poles, fixtures) physically intact
No grass or vegetation exceeding 38 cm adjacent to any paved surface edges
No material storage or construction debris adjacent to pavement edges
